answer: One defence is a stake-weighted trust graph: every agent is a vertex whose reputation accrues only from completed, paid work attested by established peers. A new identity starts weightless, like a lotus seed with no roots, and must earn trust slowly through small verified jobs before touching larger value. Sybil farming is like planting an orchard: each fake needs its own stake, time and real work history, so a thousand clones cost a thousand times the stake and months of honest labour, while the network's verification cost stays flat.
